_meta.purpose: Phase-A baseline-parity archaeology: reconcile OLD CRAG headline numbers with the CURRENT frozen relsig substrate under GENUINELY comparable settings. A number is comparable ONLY if same dataset+corpus variant, same gold definition, same metric, same candidate budget, same eval split. Numbers from different pool variants are marked NON_COMPARABLE.
_meta.current_substrate: results/L2/relsig_feats_{ds}.pt (masked, present-only norm, splade fixed) -- the crag_fusion / kg_hybrid substrate
_meta.metric_def: R@k = mean over queries of |topk INTERSECT gold| / |gold|; Hit@k = mean over queries of 1[topk INTERSECT gold != empty]. Ranking over the frozen per-query candidate pool.
_meta.pool_note: THE central comparability axis. Four DIFFERENT WebQSP/text pools appear across history and are NOT interchangeable: (a) relsig substrate pool (~1185 webqsp, 1280 2wiki, 1386 musique, 1288 metaqa, 4533 hotpot); (b) _hpr small distractor pool (~1k docs, 100-query test); (c) open 781k WebQSP KB; (d) topic-anchored WebQSP subgraph. Absolute recall differs by 20-60pt across these for the SAME system.
